selection: Four offsets relative to class zero maximize cached inner correct count minus 2*sum(offset squared), using deterministic coordinate search. Shrink halfway toward zero for the primary procedure; quarter/full offsets are fixed secondary sensitivity analyses. No outer or official validation scores select shrinkage. All base models are reused without fitting.
limitations: Cached inner probabilities come from the original inner-selected base model, so fitting scores are optimistic. Unchanged outer folds evaluate the complete new offset procedure. Repeated dataset reuse remains exploratory. Adjusted softmax values are decision scores, not calibrated clinical probabilities.
